entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION C—DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2016
entries.text:
Sec. 8106.  None of the funds made available by this Act may be used 
in contravention of the War Powers Resolution (50 U.S.C. 1541 et seq.).

                      (including transfer of funds)
